name: jewish-quarter-1967
title: The Jewish Quarter, 1967 — Ehud Netzer's planning sheets
title_he: הרובע היהודי 1967 — גיליונות התכנון של אהוד נצר
description: Ehud Netzer's 1967 planning sheets for the Jewish Quarter of Jerusalem: catalogue, georeferencing, colour-separated layers, provenance.

licenses.name: see-LICENSE
licenses.title: © Estate of Ehud Netzer; digitised and curated by Yael Netzer; licence TBD

resources.name: catalogue-sheets
resources.title: Sheet catalogue
resources.description: One record per scan (Dublin-Core-shaped): titles as written, transliteration, translation, reading confidence, creator, dates, coverage, relations, rights.

resources.name: catalogue-classes
resources.title: Legend-class catalogue
resources.description: One record per legend entry (colour class) on each sheet: legend as written, translation, kind, pigment seed, separation quality, notes.

resources.name: provenance
resources.title: Provenance
resources.description: One PROV-shaped record per derived layer: source scan (sha256), transform, parameters, software, time, agents.

resources.name: manifest
resources.title: Atlas manifest
resources.description: Machine-readable catalogue read by the web atlas: sheets, classes, fitted colours, bounds.

resources.name: reference
resources.title: Reference geometry
resources.description: City walls, Temple Mount and landmarks from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), used for georeferencing.
